intent.raw: Verificar se existe no checkout atualizado do Arcanum um episódio de observed-invocation-loop que preserve observação e reflexão suficientes para testemunhar o passo 13 do CyberAlchemy Method.
intent.objective: Produzir um testemunho local citado ou um negativo fechado sobre a operação do outer loop Reflect after use, sem executar novas capabilities nem confundir ausência de evidência versionada com falha histórica.
intent.target_artifact: Receipts nativos para síntese parent-owned sobre o passo 13.
intent.operator_sentence: Localize um episódio observado completo ou demonstre de forma fechada que o checkout não preserva testemunho suficiente.

subagent_strategy.trigger: A pergunta exige duas leituras independentes: seleção runtime-first de evidência e verificação contract-first dos limiares e artefatos de reflexão.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Context Builder limita o corpus e preserva seletores; Workflow Reflect avalia sinais e thresholds sem criar nova evidência. Os dois retornos são unidos pelo parent somente após receipts fechados.
context: O dispatch anterior encontrou recomendação reflect-now, mas não um relatório de reflexão ou o ledger central no checkout.
O Arcanum foi atualizado para 8ccc16e antes desta proposta.
O escopo permanece local, read-only e sem pesquisa web.

roles.purpose: Selecionar o menor episódio local que possa testemunhar observação, limiar, reflexão e proposta, ou retornar negativo fechado.
roles.owns: Receipt de seleção de evidência do passo 13

briefing.angle: Runtime-first: locate the smallest locally preserved observed episode before interpreting it against the method.
briefing.instructions: Use Context Builder in lean strict dry-run mode. Search only the allowed local scopes for one observed-invocation-loop episode that can witness observation, threshold evaluation, reflection, and a resulting proposal or closed negative. Start from the prior CyberAlchemy findings, preserve exact file-and-line selectors, distinguish absence of versioned evidence from execution failure, and do not combine multiple episodes into one. Return exactly one JSON object satisfying the required receipt fields; do not write files or search the web.

authority_ceiling.summary: Own only bounded local evidence selection for the step-13 witness question.

roles.purpose: Verificar independentemente se os sinais, thresholds, estado e relatórios preservados satisfazem o contrato Workflow Reflect e o passo 13.
roles.owns: Receipt de verificação de reflexão do passo 13
roles.capability_target: CyberAlchemy step 13 against preserved observability evidence

briefing.angle: Contract-first: test whether preserved signals, thresholds, reflection state, and reports satisfy the Workflow Reflect contract without inferring missing execution.
briefing.instructions: Use Workflow Reflect in dry-run mode only. Inspect the allowed local observability scopes and the prior CyberAlchemy findings. Determine whether any single preserved episode contains enough valid signals to trigger reflection and whether a reflection report or explicit proposal closes CyberAlchemy step 13. If the default ledger is absent or below threshold, return an evidence-backed closed negative rather than creating signals or reports. Return exactly one JSON object satisfying the required receipt fields; do not write files or search the web.

authority_ceiling.summary: Own only read-only contract verification for the step-13 witness question.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Executar dois agentes locais e read-only em paralelo para localizar ou fechar negativamente o testemunho do passo 13?

steps.name: Selecionar evidência local do passo 13
stop_conditions: stop with a closed negative when no single versioned episode witnesses observation through reflection
stop if the evidence boundary would require web research or repository mutation

steps.name: Verificar thresholds e reflexão preservada

capability_metadata.validation_note: Run in dry-run read-only mode; no report or state mutation.

stop_conditions: stop with insufficient-evidence status when the signal ledger is absent or below threshold
never create a reflection report or update reflection state

gates.condition: Both agents return complete, cited receipts, keep episodes distinct, and classify the claim as witnessed, partial, or closed-negative without treating missing versioned evidence as execution failure.
The final synthesis does not claim end-to-end step-13 operation unless one preserved episode witnesses signals, threshold evaluation, reflection, and resulting proposal or state change.

boundaries.contract: Return selector-level local evidence or a closed negative; no writes or cross-episode synthesis.
Return dry-run threshold and reflection verification only; no report, state update, or observed-capability mutation.

promotion_guardrails: The result is evidence about method operation, not authority to modify or promote the CyberAlchemy Method.
A closed negative triggers a decision about instrumentation or evidence retention, not a fabricated reflection record.
